PUT https://developer.api.autodesk.com/hq/v1/regions/eu/accounts/:account_id/business_units_structure
app only
account:write
JSON
Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is obtained via a two-legged OAuth flow.
Must be application/json.

Specifies the region where the service is located.                                                                                                        Possible values: US, EMEA. For the full list of supported regions, see the Regions page.
The account/hub ID of the business unit. This corresponds to the hub ID used in the Data Management API, with the “b." prefix removed. For example, b.c8b0c73d-3ae9 becomes c8b0c73d-3ae9.

Business unit ID

If specified and already existing, the existing business unit will be replaced
with the provided attributes.

If specified and not already existing, a new business unit will be created with the id.

If unspecified, a new business unit will be created with a server-generated id.

The ID of the parent business unit

Note that an entire business unit hierarchy can be created by manually specifying the id
attribute for each business unit and using it as appropriate in other parent_id
attributes.
The name of the business unit
The description of the business unit
